crossRefs.note: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol…
When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said…
There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill…
They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north…
Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
translations.bsb: And from there they traveled to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
translations.kjv: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
translations.asv: And they passed thence unto the hill-country of Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
